export.title: Organization export
export.description: All organization data for further use: Excel tables (members, events, attendance, fines, finances, tasks, lists), the PDFs of closed minutes and optionally photos, submissions and documents as original files. Without credentials. The export is created in the background and can be downloaded for 7 days. Requires a sign-in confirmed with two-factor authentication.

export.hint: AES-256 encrypted. Open with e.g. 7-Zip (Windows), Keka (macOS) or WinRAR.

fileVisibility.title: File visibility

activity.privacyHint: Successful sign-ins stay visible here for 30 days, failed attempts and changes longer. Anyone who opens this log appears in it too. Please mention this logging in your organisation's privacy notice.

retention.intro: Decide how long the organization keeps certain data. All rules are off until you switch them on. hocX suggests matching entries every day; you confirm or dismiss them. Former members are locked automatically from the day after they leave; their data is kept.

submissions_months.label: Delete upload box submissions after the deadline

retention.applyConfirm: {count, plural, one {Apply one suggestion?} other {Apply # suggestions?}} Submissions and gallery images are deleted permanently, members are deactivated.

replacesDomainHint: Replaces {domain} once verification succeeds. Until then, {domain} stays active unchanged.

dnsIntroShort: Add these two records for {domain} at your domain provider (where the domain is registered), then click «Verify now».

dnsWaitHint: New DNS records often take a few minutes, sometimes up to a few hours. Only check once both records are set: 20 checks per hour are possible. Use «Finish later» to come back at any time.

help.domains: A custom domain (e.g. app.example.ch) makes hocX, the submission box or the verification page available under your own address. There is one active domain per purpose; a new one only replaces it after successful verification.
help.dns: The TXT record proves that you own the domain. The CNAME record points the address to hocX. A root domain without a prefix (example.ch) cannot have a CNAME with many providers – use a subdomain such as app.example.ch or an A record pointing to the same IP address as the target.
help.modules: «Active» means fully usable. «Read only» means the module is no longer part of your subscription, but your data is kept and readable; changes are blocked until the module is booked again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait about an hour and try again.

errors.domain_reserved: This domain belongs to hocX itself and cannot be added.
errors.domain_domain_taken: This domain is already active for another organization.
errors.domain_already_active: This domain is already active for this purpose.
errors.domain_txt_missing: The TXT record {record} with the verification value was not found yet. Check name and value at your domain provider or wait until the change has propagated.
errors.domain_not_routed: {domain} does not point to {target} yet. Check the CNAME or A record or wait until the change has propagated.

renameRevokesVerificationConfirm: Your organization is verified by hocX. Changing the name revokes this verification, and new PDFs will no longer be shown as verified. You can request it again under Settings › Domains & authenticity. Save anyway?

security.privacyHint: To protect accounts, hocX stores the time, rough device, a pseudonym of the network and – if set up – the country of each sign-in (looked up locally with “IP to Country Lite” by DB-IP.com, CC BY 4.0), never the IP address; events are deleted after 90 days. New passwords are checked anonymously against known data breaches: only the first 5 characters of a hash are sent to “Have I Been Pwned”. Please mention both in your organisation's privacy notice (legitimate interest: account security).
